descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-05 Keeping Data Secure / Real-PHI Readiness Gate · S20 「按 PII 实体和期望动作看 guardrail，在生产和 UAT 部署上」 Guardrail by PII entity and expected action, on production and on the UAT deployment

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U7 The guardrail configuration (ADDRESS/PHONE = None) and the model ID are version-pinned in production and match what UAT ran on.（UAT OAT-05；UAT 3.1；TFA-94059 AC 6） — gate: blocked: TFA-94059 in progress
  • T3 Every AI call, including Ask AI and Handoff, goes out from server-side Convex actions with the Bedrock guardrail applied.（TFA-92568 AC 13；TFA-92568 Eng 2） — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress

测试设计方法：决策表（decision-table） — 几个条件的组合列成表，每个组合各验一次，看结果是不是按规则变。

Given The guardrail and version each deployment uses (BEDROCK_GUARDRAIL_ID and VERSION), read with 'aws bedrock get-guardrail' by Tim, and infra/stacks/aws.ts at the deployed commit

When Fill the table, one row per entity: PHONE, ADDRESS, EMAIL, SSN, card. Columns: action on production, action on the UAT deployment, action in infra code. Add the version type (numbered or DRAFT), whether BEDROCK_GUARDRAIL_ID and BEDROCK_GUARDRAIL_VERSION are set on each deployment's Convex env (names only; …

Then PHONE and ADDRESS are None on production, on the UAT deployment and in infra code. The other entities are the same on both deployments. The guardrail ID and version are set on both. The version is numbered and published. Bedrock refuses invocation without the guardrail.

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT OAT-05 step 7 and UAT 3.1 (ADDRESS/PHONE actions set to None); TFA-92568 AC 13 (guardrail applied). PHONE or ADDRESS other than None on either deployment, or in the infra code that would restore it, is a Fail. A config that differs between production and UAT is a Fail. DRAFT and the other entities are judged per Q6.

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 CONFIG · 配置核对；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S20 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-05.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：CONFIG · 配置核对；辅助：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 dev 跑；来源：dev。
